components.name: Mason witness-slack and infinity-contact proof-state calibration
components.project_addition: Decompose the classical Mason proof margin into residual-absorption slack and Wronskian-capacity slack; identify the latter exactly with the finite normalized leading-coefficient contact depth at infinity; and use same-final-margin/different-internal-slack examples to pressure-test the distinction between decision precision and proof-provenance precision. The Wronskian algebra and Mason-Stothers theorem remain prior art; the finite-precision proof-state integration is novelty-unverified.
